newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn ends mixed, underpinned by soybean gain.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn ends mixed, underpinned by soybean gain.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed mixed with the market underpinned by another day of gains in soybeans, traders said.
"There was a little movement overnight and some early hedging but corn followed soybeans again," a trader said.

Volume in corn was trimmed at the expense of the strong bull move in the soy complex, especially in soybeans and soymeal, traders said. Corn sagged early as soybeans showed occasional signs of breaking with pressure on corn also coming from news Taiwan passed on a cargo of U.S. corn which was a possible forerunner of a rocky road for corn exports.

The market took in stride USDA's weekly export data which showed U.S. net export sales of corn for the week ended February 6 at 883,900 tonnes, at the high end of expectations for 700,000 to 900,000 tonnes.

Technicians cited first support in March corn at $2.72 and second support at $2.69-1/4. The session low for March was $2.72-1/2. First resistance was at $2.74-3/4 and second resistance was at $2.77-1/2. The session high for March was $2.74-3/4.
Corn closed one cent per bushel higher to 1/2 lower, with March up 3/4 at $2.74-1/2 a bushel.
